name: assay_definition_v1
source: User-supplied answers to the six assay questions recorded in reports/RNA-StableAI_HANDOFF_2026-10-19_V6.md
purpose: Record the intended experimental assay so that RiboNN named-task selection and the stability/translation floors have a defined target. This config defines the assay only; it selects no task, freezes no floor, and amends no gate.

readouts.name: rt_qpcr_mrna
readouts.measures: in-cell mRNA abundance over time, used for RNA stability
readouts.units: relative abundance; decay rate or half-life derived

cell_types.note: The user wrote 'crossing different cell type as well, e.q. A549 and T-cell'. A549 is unambiguous; the T-cell type is not yet pinned to a primary cell or a line.

measurement_error.power_note: Computed for a two-sample t-test, alpha 0.05 two-sided, 80% power, detecting a 1.5-fold change: n=3 per group requires CV at or below about 14.1 percent; n=4 about 18.6; n=5 about 22.2; n=6 about 25.3. The declared design of 3 replicates is therefore adequate only if the assay CV is at or below roughly 14 percent.

design_space.note: This is the same thing the Stage 2 to Stage 3 gate requires frozen as parents and allowed edits. It is recorded here as the stated experimental design, not frozen as an optimization space; freezing that remains behind the gate review.
design_space.codon_usage_observation: The supplied reference CDS already sits at GC3 0.996, essentially maximal human codon optimization, so codon-usage variation from this starting point can realistically only reduce GC3. Codon changes also move GC content and folding free energy, which are STRAND features, so stability-side predictions respond to codon edits as well as UTR edits.

reference_construct.pending_from: colleague referred to as Ping; the user wrote 'use Ping's sequence as a model when you receive the sequence from him'

validation.identity_assessment: N-terminal sequence and 550 aa length are consistent with firefly luciferase. Not aligned against a reference database, so the exact variant is not asserted.

utrs.blocking: A scorable transcript requires 5' UTR + CDS + 3' UTR. RiboNN additionally requires integer utr5_size and cds_size. Neither component can score this construct until the UTR scaffold is supplied.
utrs.strand_comparison_note: STRAND's released constructs used hHBB 5' and 3' UTRs; whether this assay uses the same scaffold is unknown.

quantity_mismatches_recorded.predicts: in-solution RNA half-life, purified RNA in buffer, hours
quantity_mismatches_recorded.relationship: different quantities. In-cell decay involves deadenylation, decapping, exonucleolytic and miRNA-directed pathways absent from a buffer degradation measurement. The assay therefore does not validate either stability model against its own target; it can only test correlation.
quantity_mismatches_recorded.permitted_claim: correlation with in-cell stability, explicitly labelled as such

quantity_mismatches_recorded.predicts: translational efficiency of endogenous human transcripts, released task scale
quantity_mismatches_recorded.assay_measures: luminescence from a designed reporter construct
quantity_mismatches_recorded.relationship: related but not identical. The tasks are trained on endogenous transcripts; a designed Fluc reporter is out-of-distribution, and luminescence is not the task's target scale.
quantity_mismatches_recorded.permitted_claim: ranking or correlation, not calibrated prediction

quantity_mismatches_recorded.predicts: nothing in the stack predicts relative light units
quantity_mismatches_recorded.assay_measures: expression in the assay's own units
quantity_mismatches_recorded.relationship: a model of the assay readout would have to be fitted against the lab's own measurements.
quantity_mismatches_recorded.permitted_claim: none until such a model exists and is independently evaluated

resolved_by_this_config: The intended assay is now defined, which was V3 blocker 1.
V3 blocker 2, that no released task is cell-free, is moot: the assay is in transfected cells, and matching released tasks exist.
still_blocking: No per-task released accuracy evidence is held locally; only per-checkpoint validation R2, 0.4847 to 0.5372 across 50 human checkpoints. Upstream per-task metrics have not been retrieved.
Per-task training overlap with any candidate sequence set remains unknown, as V12 and V13 record.
The T-cell type is not yet pinned, so the T-cell task cannot be chosen.
A designed Fluc reporter is out-of-distribution for tasks trained on endogenous transcripts; applicability needs its own argument.
ribonn_task_selection.rule: A task may be selected only in its own versioned config, citing per-task accuracy evidence and an explicit applicability argument. Name matching between a cell line and a task label is not evidence.

blocking: Assay CV was not supplied, and configs/score_record_schema_v1_2026-10-19.json requires measurement error before any floor may be frozen.
No decision cost is stated: what a false accept and a false reject cost in the planned experiment.
The 1.5-fold figure is a target effect size, not an acceptance threshold on a model score.
floor_selection.rule: Floors must be frozen in their own versioned config. This config does not freeze one.

gate_conflict.consequence: The recorded Stage 3 target and the lab's actual assay disagree. Published material repeats the cell-free framing, including the README's cell-free first-target statement and handoffs V13 and earlier.
gate_conflict.resolution_required: A gate review decision by the user: amend the Stage 3 target to the transfected-cell assay, or keep cell-free as the target and treat this assay as a separate proxy track.
gate_conflict.prohibition: This config does not amend the gate, the scope or any published claim. gate_amended is false.

no_claim_permitted: Defining an assay establishes no stability, translation or expression benefit.
No Stage 2 gate requirement is satisfied by this config; the structure-validation requirements are independent of the assay.
No sequence may be scored for this assay until the UTR scaffold and the authoritative construct sequence are supplied.
Cell-line name matching does not justify a RiboNN task selection.
